summary: DockerImages Jenkinsfile gains a digest-pinned trivy 0.74.0 sidecar. Each built image is scanned right after its push, CRITICAL/HIGH tables are printed, and an image with any fixable CRITICAL raises one notify.warning; the scan sits in catchError(SUCCESS/SUCCESS, catchInterruptions: false) under trivy's own --timeout 15m, so it never changes the build result. Parse-checked under Groovy 2.4 and exercised against the live registry:5000 with stubbed steps; DockerImages cce00ff on phase/020-P6, plan record in AnsibleSpecs 9b88ad0.
